AUTH.minimum: Valid actor and missing/invalid credentials; required operation grant or intentional lack of grant; credential priority and no unauthorized state.
AUTH.limit: Do not require a new grant where pinned source intentionally permits a read.

HTTP.minimum: Pinned status/body/content type, empty204, native JSON/PHP encoding; wrong method/HEAD/OPTIONS/CORS; encoded path and configured API prefix boundaries.
HTTP.limit: Framework mounting alone is not behavior parity; v2 canonicalization is outside baseline.

READ.minimum: Successful nonempty and empty/null DTOs; missing IDs; declared fields/types; stable filtering/order/paging where supported; no unintended domain writes.

MUTATE.minimum: Successful response plus persisted row/amount/log effects, rejected/missing target and repeated actions, no unauthorized write; source commit/rollback boundaries when the operation has multiple stages.
MUTATE.limit: No blanket atomic rollback requirement: source-confirmed partial writes are part of the contract.

OBJECTS.minimum: 33 listable entities; blocked api_keys reads/create/update, read-only/edit/delete restrictions; LessQL query registration/comparison; purifier/SQL types, missing IDs, userfield maps including numeric-key arrays.

USERFIELDS.minimum: Saved values versus absent placeholders; field order/types; numeric object/name keys, purifier/default and partial-write behavior.

FILES.minimum: Real upload/read/delete content and filename, no overwrite/path escape, interrupted upload cleanup; strict native path encoding, rawPHP query scalar/array registration; image MIME/cache/dimensions with actualGD.
FILES.limit: Named page links and frontend previews are not API completion gates.

USERS.minimum: Source raw DTO/password behavior; create/edit/self-edit/delete permission; defaults; key/session revocation and retained historical rows, no password disclosure.

PERMISSIONS.minimum: Read/add/replace stored permission rows and hierarchy; self-admin changes, absent users/raw body handling, source failure and partial persistence.

SETTINGS.minimum: Current-user ownership, saved/default/null/reset behavior, numeric keys/rawPHP values and input purification; persistent scalar type/empty distinctions.

STOCK_READ.minimum: Native stock/product/entry/booking/transaction DTOs including child stock, opened counts, locations/prices; query/coercion/missing-record errors.

STOCK_WRITE.minimum: Purchase/consume/open/transfer/inventory quantities, units/entry selection and dates/prices; booking-array or empty204; source side effects and stage failures/undo.

BARCODE.minimum: Case/encoded/raw Grocy barcode lookup and optional amount/unit/entry data; unknown lookup precedes action permission; successful delegated action affects the selected product.

SHOPPING.minimum: Native list selection/default and integer/decimal amount rules; duplicate/removal/done-only/threshold effects; bulk missing/overdue/expired selection persists correct items.

UNDO.minimum: Correct booking/execution/cycle/task reversal, repeated/missing target errors, metadata/history and transaction-scope effects; permissions and source partial failure behavior.

MERGE.minimum: Distinct canonical IDs, self/missing/permission errors, complete quantity/history/reference migration and source partial-write failure behavior.

RECIPES.minimum: Fulfillment/cost/quantity/nesting/servings; selected shopping items; consumption/output/copy graph and source labels; committed earlier stages on tested later failure.

HOUSEHOLD.minimum: Current/details DTOs; raw dates/date-only/year-zero, skipped/last-success distinction; task complete/undo and battery count/last charge; schedule/assignment and error/permission boundaries.

PRINT_API.minimum: Declared label/thermal payloads and response failures; feature modes, exact HTTP webhook/network/file sink output and failure timing.
PRINT_API.limit: A physical printer, frontend label dialog and hardware are explicitly excluded.

EXTERNAL_LOOKUP.minimum: Controlled plugin HTTP result/errors, add flag and master grant before lookup; persistent product/barcode/image/conversion output and source partial writes.

CALENDAR.minimum: Valid/invalid/zero-year dates, UTC and Europe/Bucharest/DST serialization/escaping/folding; source sharing-key scope/rotation and invalid secret behavior.

SYSTEM.minimum: Pinned info/config/localization/time DTOs, settings/default precedence and timezone/offset rules; DB-change signal excludes key bookkeeping; development logging adds no new production effect.

FEATURE_PROFILE.minimum: Existing CI disabled-feature profile for tasks/chores/batteries/recipes/date/freezing/price flags; source behavior, not invented universal403.
